style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: a motorised belt hauls a wall of mink coats right to left in EVERY beat while she strides left along it on her own legs in EVERY beat, so coats and tags tear past her at double speed; she never sits, never rides, never holds a pose; a near coat wipes the lens every beat; she fills half the frame height, chest up from 6.8; camera rides beside her low and level, moving every beat, new shot size each beat; one clear action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor darting ahead at lens all clip, never still; A SWARM of moths crossing the lens with a dry flutter in every beat
props: ONE fat folder of bills inside her coat; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; packed mink coats on brass hangers; paper price tags on every coat; ONE red-stamped bill; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the strip of bills whips behind her from 1.3 on, never parked; the folder rides inside her coat until 1.3; the chewed sleeve is her own
environment: a sun-flooded aisle jammed wall to wall with mink coats on two belt rails, brass hangers, mirrors, fluttering tags, every shelf stuffed with fur

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, shub, NOR-ki, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath; pause 4.3-4.7; 4.7-6.8 one breath; after 6.8 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: belt rumble all clip, dry wing flutter, paper riffling, fur ripping, one wet spit at 7.6

timeline.a: she strides into frame against the belt, the coat wall tearing past the other way
she walks left chewing her own sleeve while a mink coat sweeps across the lens and clears
she yanks the folder from her coat and a long strip of bills bursts open and whips across the whole frame
she shoulders through a hanging mink coat, the fur splitting wide open across the lens as she keeps walking
she swats a row of brass hangers and they clatter away past the lens, coats swinging wide
she rounds a bend at a stride, the strip whipping out long behind her, price tags tearing loose
the clerk moth slaps a red-stamped bill onto the strip at lens, both dragged right to left off frame
she cuts across the aisle to the far rail, a wall of coats sweeping between her and the lens
she leans out at the lens mid-stride, hangers and tags tearing past behind her
she strides past the last stripped hanger, the swarm tearing across the lens after her
chest-up close shot: still walking, she bites her own sleeve and rips a strip of fur off it, coats streaking behind
she spits the chewed fur straight at the lens, face to camera, still striding as the coat wall hauls past

must_appear: at 2.2 she shoulders through a hanging coat and the fur splits open across the lens; at 6.8 chest-up, she bites her own sleeve and chews; at 7.4 she spits the wad at the lens, face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped belt, a bare shelf, an empty white wall, a hero sitting, a hero riding a cart, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 6.8
